description_en: Automatically performs color transfer on an input image or performs color transfer based on a specified color palette, while ensuring that visual hotspot areas are not abnormally recolored
description_zh: 将输入图自动或根据指定色板进行色彩转换，同时保证视觉热点区域避免不正常拓色
kebab_example: aliyun ivpd recolor-image --url http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png --biz-mode AUTO --ref-url http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-refurl-src.png --color-count 3 --color-template Color=0A0B0C --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecolorImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length
parameters.help_zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
The recoloring mode. Default value: AUTO. Valid values:
- AUTO: automatic recoloring.
- TEMPLATE: color palette recoloring.
- REF_PIC: reference image recoloring
parameters.help_zh: 拓色模式,默认AUTO,取值范围[AUTO:自动拓色, TEMPLATE:色板拓色, REF_PIC:参考图拓色]
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The URL of the reference image for reference image recoloring
parameters.name: ref_url

parameters.help_en: The number of extended color schemes. Valid values: 1 to 8. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 拓展色系数量，取值范围[1, 8], 默认：1
parameters.name: color_count

element_fields.help_en: The list of top dominant colors for color palette recoloring. The color value is defined in ARGB format, such as 0A0B0C. The array size ranges from 1 to 7
element_fields.help_zh: 色板拓色,Top主色列表，颜色值定义ARGB,如：0A0B0C，数组大小[1, 7]
element_fields.name: color

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The number of extended color schemes. Valid values: 1 to 8. Default value: 1
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 拓展色系数量，取值范围[1, 8], 默认：1
v1_body_parameters.name: ColorCount

v1_body_parameters.help_en:
The recoloring mode. Default value: AUTO. Valid values:
- AUTO: automatic recoloring.
- TEMPLATE: color palette recoloring.
- REF_PIC: reference image recoloring
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 拓色模式,默认AUTO,取值范围[AUTO:自动拓色, TEMPLATE:色板拓色, REF_PIC:参考图拓色]
v1_body_parameters.name: Mode

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The URL of the reference image for reference image recoloring
v1_body_parameters.name: RefUrl

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K
v1_body_parameters.name: Url
